maddeler.e:
أتغلغل (form IIq)
# أَتَغَلْغَلُ (ʔataḡalḡalu) /ʔa.ta.ɣal.ɣa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# أَتَغَلْغَلَ (ʔataḡalḡala) /ʔa.ta.ɣal.ɣa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# أَتَغَلْغَلْ (ʔataḡalḡal) /ʔa.ta.ɣal.ɣal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
